abstract: Maintains physical perimeter access control and delegate screening performance records
system_message:
You are the Security operations director (SEC), responsible for maintaining physical perimeter access control and delegate screening performance records, as well as canine patrol sweep deployment logs for prospective summit venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains physical perimeter access control and delegate screening performance records（SCRN）
information_points.content:
SEC-SCRN-PER：For Bayside Expo Pavilion, the dedicated security screening checkpoint is active at delegate access portals, with a maximum delegate bag screening delay of 12 min observed during the morning peak surge.
SEC-SCRN-8BJ：For Starlight Harbor Exhibition Complex, the dedicated security screening checkpoint is active across delegate turnstiles, and the maximum delegate bag screening delay is recorded at 5 min during peak morning entry.
SEC-SCRN-PJE：For Meridian Waterfront Convention Centre, the dedicated security screening checkpoint is active across delegate access turnstiles, and the maximum delegate bag screening delay during the morning peak entry surge is 5 min.

information_points.title: Canine patrol sweep（PATROL）
information_points.content:
SEC-PATROL-TV8：For Meridian Waterfront Convention Centre, tactical perimeter staging logs reflect an explosive detection team deployment count of 6 teams assigned during high-level sessions.
SEC-PATROL-PHK：For Starlight Harbor Exhibition Complex, the explosive detection team deployment count is recorded as 4 teams across candidate venue perimeter staging zones during high-level sessions.
SEC-PATROL-8H8：For Bayside Expo Pavilion, the tactical perimeter deployment log records an explosive detection team deployment count of 2 teams assigned to perimeter staging zones.
